lifecycle.intro: Kagaz AI runs entirely on your device — nothing you type or ask ever leaves your phone.

mode.online_hint: Online: your messages and any document you transcribe are sent to Google Cloud (Vertex AI).
mode.offline_hint: Offline: nothing is sent to Google.
mode.warning_title: Send your data to Google Cloud?
mode.warning_body: Online mode sends your chat messages — and any document you ask the assistant to read or transcribe — to Google Cloud (Vertex AI) so a larger model can answer. This can include personal information such as ID numbers. Offline mode keeps everything on this device. Turn on online mode?
